description: This PHP class defines the SendmailCommand, a console command within the Goteo project that handles sending individual emails based on a mailer_send table, including locking mechanisms and optional update dispatching.

classes.name: SendmailCommand
classes.description: A console command class for processing and sending individual emails from the mailer_send table, with locking mechanisms and optional message updating.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the console command with name, description, arguments, options, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command: retrieves the recipient by ID, checks if already sent, applies locking, dispatches the email, and handles exceptions.
